items.title: Ertuğrul Doğan: Devre arası için Thomas Reis'in talepleri değerlendirilecek
items.prompt: Minimal still life on a dark wooden desk: only a fountain pen, two sheets of plain blank white paper and a folded knitted scarf in dark burgundy (deep claret) and light sky blue colors, nothing else on the desk, warm desk lamp light. Color editorial sports photograph, full-frame camera, 35mm lens at f/2, natural light, shallow depth of field, realistic colors, fine detail, subtle film grain, calm atmospheric mood.
